== Summary ==
Japanese missing-forfeit variant of [[Bespin Motors Void Spider THX 1138 (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/starwarscollector-1/imagegallery/127305 StarWarsCollector_#1's PSA gallery], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/193682431/We7n7nNU0kOaSFkbAtQuLw.jpg exact source photograph], PSA certificate 137991304.

Crop rectangle <code>(258, 1150, 2333, 4000)</code>. Source SHA-256 <code>03530eb5f04c86470cac9cc41215e87a52dfee96ce68224a1a9238a234583e03</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd., 1996, and Decipher Inc., 1997.
